Nothing recent enough to compare against.

Fresh produce is not something Shin can price yet. Three problems stack and none of them is solved by a better feed. A PLU names a category rather than a product (4011 has meant "bananas" since 1990), package formats break unit comparison, and the public series measures underlying inflation rather than what is on the shelf this week. Shopper-reported shelf prices are the only source here, not a supplement to one.

rows.line: Not sure enough this is the right used goods. The closest match was "Canon EOS R6, used body". Pick the right one and Shin will price it. (free search answered with a Canon EOS R6 Mark II bundled with lenses at about $4,800: a different camera at nearly triple. Every price attached to it was accurate. Separately observed and not usable as points: eBay sold listings under US$2,000, which is a bound in another currency, and new Canadian retail of $2,352 to $3,099, which is not a used comparable.)
